book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: Ka Paul Mooe Tubona Mu Corinth-witu Tunaka'oedyukudu-matoo

content: Ka pukwi mu tutummatzipu-matu mu tumasumudoopu-witu sakwa nu mu tuukwe. Nu mu tunaka'oedyukudu tutuha manedu Jerusalem-witu mu tummatzikwuna sookwa'e. Mu sakwa tumasumudoo mana mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka teepu Galatia mee naneadu-kwitu yoo mane tuungu. Mu sakwa punno'o ooosoo.

Ka nono'otsa mu nanesootuhi sumu-kwi'yoona, mu sakwa tumasumudooyina ka Te Naa mumme sootuhipu-matu, ka mu tumasumudooyina tsipunne. O'no yise ka e petugase oosoo namamakwupunnedooa. O'no yise nu gi tumasumudoona mu natuungu-wa'ne'yoosoo.
Nu ka mu-baa petugase tooe haga tooe saa'a mu tunetutzeapu, ka mu tumasumudoona noko ka mu tubope-noko Jerusalem-witoo tayadooa. Soo tubope saa'a umu-witusoo wahadu.
Too'e saa'a nu umu-no meadooa ka oo mane-wa'ne'yoona. O'no yise umu nu-no napua'a-gadooa.
Nu ka teepu Macedonia mee naneadu-too mease, nu sumuna mu-baa gi haa'notoo nobengekakwu.
Tooetoo nu sumuna mu-baa tomokwu. Mu sumuna e tummatzikwu, ka penakwa e mease tooe hanotoo tooe.
Gi haa'noto nu mu nobengena, nu sakwa wuna'me mu-baa ka Te Pabe'e nuka meeoo sooyugwe.

Pana nu yaa ka Ephesus mee naneadu-kwi'yookwusoo ka tu nayasana mu mamakwunoto tooe yaano'yoopunnekwu, nu ewasoo ka Te Pabe'e-witu mu numu mesoo tunesootabuedooa, tooe meno'o ewa'yoo numu ne tumoo'oogena sapa ka te nanesootuhi-kwi.
Ka Timothy mu-baa petugase, ka saa'a besa oo matugu. O'no oosoo besa mu napua'a nuummadooa. Oosoo nu-kwa'ne'yoosoo, oosoo Te Pabe'e yadooawabe.
Mu sakwa no'yoona besa oo matuguna, oo tummatzi, o'no yise oosoo yabesoo nu-baatoosoo kodyudooa besa soonammena, numme ka mu tunaka'oedyukudu-no oo soogwipunne.

Soo Apollos sakwa too'e, mu susumudu nananesootuhidu-no mu-baa nobenge, mee'e nu oo tooe netamma. “Gi nu meno'o oo mani-kwa'ne'yoona,” mee soo Apollos. Pana sumuna soo Apollos saa'a mumme nanekwegeakwu.
Mu sakwa ooosapa namabetzapepunne ooosapa ka Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukuna, mu sakwa gi suipana tooe hemma ha'oo manese sapa. Natzooesoo nasooyugwepunne.
No'okosoo hemma how mu yugwekwi mu sakwa besa nanasoobedya.

Meno'o yise, e pupua'amu, mu sakwa ka Stephanas mee naneadu ka oo nobe-kwitunosoo besa umu-no nananetummatzi. Umuoo numu ka Te Pabe'e-wi mooe tunaka'oedyukupu, ka mu tubewa-wi'yoona, ka mumme tunaka'oedyukudu sootummatzina. Mu sakwa tuwazoo no'oko mu tunaka'oedyukudu tummatzidu tummatzi.
Nu besa soonamme ka Stephanas, Portunas noko Achaicus nu-baa petuse, umu ka nu-baa'yoona, tooe mumme gi nu-baakoo sapa.
Umu nu-baa petuse, mu mane-kwitu besa nemadabue. Umu besa e masoonamme, yise besa mu masoonammekwu tuwow, ka mu-baa petugase. Mu sakwa umuoo naana sootubetseya'e.
Umu tunaka'oedyukudu yaa Asia-kooba nonobe-ga'yoo mu nema'yu. Umu Aquila noko Priscilla mu tunaka'oedyukudu umu-no mu nobe-kwi sumuyakwe,
no'yoona yise mu tunaka'oedyukudu yaatu mu nema'yuyakwe. Mu sakwa nananeno'yugwe.
Nu, nuusoo, ka umu ume nemayudu unnena yow botugumena.
Soo Te Pabe'e saa'a tamme-baa petudooa. Tooe haga tooe ka gi Te Pabe'e petzabena, soo suda mu tumatuguna umu-matoosoo kodyukwu.
Nu meeoo nanesootuhidyikwu, “Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus sakwa besa mu sootuhi.”
Nu no'oko unu mu soobedya, mumme ka Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukudu.
